meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 会接入 iMessage 频道:本地模式读取这台 Mac 的聊天库(需完全磁盘访问),远程模式通过 Photon 服务器收发。配好你的手机号或 Apple ID 并重启后,机器人会用该地址发来欢迎消息,你就能在 iMessage 中回复。
howto.when: 当你说出“add imessage”“connect imessage”“add photon”等触发词时触发。

say.note: 先问你要本地还是 Photon 远程。

say.text: 用 Photon 远程接 iMessage
say.note: 会让你填服务器地址和 API Key。

say.text: 用这台 Mac 本地接入 iMessage
say.note: 需要 macOS 和完全磁盘访问。

howto.what_en: NanoClaw gains an iMessage channel. It can send/receive locally via this Mac's chat database (needs Full Disk Access) or remotely via a Photon server. Your phone number/Apple ID is the conversation address; after restart, the bot greets you there and you can chat.
howto.when_en: Triggers on trigger phrases such as 'add imessage', 'connect imessage', 'add photon', etc.

say_en.note: Prompts for Photon URL and API key.

say_en.text: Use native iMessage on this Mac.
